name: 14431-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine, one model worker, no sharding.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 4000 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion. 512 is a starting point rather than a pinned point: it is the plainest value that saturates one H100 at this prompt/output shape while staying under the engine's 1024-sequence ceiling.
workload: ShareGPT V3 conversational prompts, single turn, shipped as configs/data/sharegpt-v3-llama3-4000.jsonl (4000 rows, guidellm json_file): prompt mean 222.1 tokens (p50 103, max 1021), output mean 199.7 (p50 133, max 1838). Sent RAW -- scenario.json declares request_format: plain -- with ignore_eos, so each request generates exactly its row's completion length.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant handling varied single-turn conversations for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.7.3-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# V1 selection and the attention backend are environment variables at this commit, not keys here.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

dtype: bfloat16
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
